transcription.notes: Blitz round of the Olympiad of Metropolises 2019: 80 short multi-subject questions (physics, mathematics, informatics, chemistry) with no points printed and no solutions file in the archive. Answer options (1), 2), ...) are kept in the statement in printed order; options printed on one line are given one per paragraph. The program listings of problems 18, 20, 40 and 70 and the reaction scheme of problem 76 are printed as raster images (absent from the text layer); the program listings are kept as figure crops of those images (the site MDX checker rejects braces and << in code), with the code spelled out in the alt text, and the reaction scheme is transcribed as LaTeX. Line-end hyphenations (inte-gers, pre-sented, concen-trated, ex-ample, with-out, com-mon) are joined. Printed forms kept verbatim: "sprinters speed" (problem 37, no apostrophe), "waterpool" (problem 54), "brutto formula" and "0 C" (problem 71), "milliliters ... solution is needed" (problem 6, number agreement kept as printed), "O(nlogn)" (problem 38). The catalogue lists 12 problem titles; the paper prints 80 numbered questions.

problems.statement:
A sled starts sliding on a horizontal section of a road under the influence of constant force of 150 N directed at an angle of $60^{\circ}$ to the horizontal. After the first 10 m covered by the sled, its kinetic energy increased by 200 J. Determine the magnitude of the friction force acting on the sled.

The answer should be given in the SI units unless otherwise stated. If the numerical result turns out to be an integer, it should be given as the answer. Otherwise round the result to the first decimal. $g = 10\ \mathrm{m/s^2}$.
